svg.title: HAL system architecture
svg.desc: AI agents ask the HAL API before every purchase. The API checks the rules, records the decision in PostgreSQL, pays approved sellers in USDC on Solana, and the web app lets people approve, stop and review.
svg.text: How a purchase travels from an AI agent to a paid seller, and what checks it on the way.
Keys and secrets live only in server settings
Paid data APIs, charged per request
with their own key, never the wallet
